claims: The Artemis II crew returned to Earth on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The date of the Artemis II return was Friday, April 10, 2026.
The location of the Artemis II return was the Pacific Ocean near San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Orion spacecraft completed the Artemis II mission.
Recovery teams from the USS John P. Murtha secured the capsule and crew shortly after the Artemis II landing.
The Artemis II crew consisted of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II was the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
